subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the stale SHA assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should the 14-action upgrade be accepted as one privileged workflow batch?
rationale: The mechanical defects are clear, but accepting updated third-party code across token-bearing, security-scanning, release, and agent workflows remains an explicit owner decision under the protected security label.

options.title: Repair and approve the batch
options.body: Update all three guarded assertions, require clean exact-head workflow/security checks, and then approve the verified official release pins together.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Separate token, release, scanning, and Codex Action updates into smaller PRs for narrower owner review and rollback.

options.title: Keep current pins
options.body: Close or supersede this batch and retain the existing action SHAs until maintainers choose a later upgrade window.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve the batch
recommendation.body: Update all three guarded assertions, require clean exact-head workflow/security checks, and then approve the verified official release pins together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows ownership of the central CI and performance workflow contracts, with CODEOWNERS routing the broader workflow surface through this account and security owners.
